name: My Son's Girlfriend is WAY TOO HOT to ignore!!!
source: When my son came home for Christmas vacation, I expected the usual quiet holidays... until he walked through the front door with his new girlfriend. I couldn't believe a wimp like him managed to bag such a fox! From the second I laid eyes on her, I knew this Christmas would be unforgettable.
translation: 儿子放圣诞假回家时，我本以为这又会是个如往常般清静平淡的假期……直到他领着新交的女朋友跨进了家门。我简直不敢相信，他这么个窝囊小子居然能泡到如此火辣的极品尤物！从第一眼看到她的那一秒起，我就知道今年这个圣诞节注定令人终生难忘。
